class.name: IfcMechanicalFastenerType
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI : The element type ( IfcMechanicalFastenerType ) defines a list of commonly shared property set definitions of a fastener and an optional set of product representations. It is used to define mechanical fasteners mainly within structural and building services domains (i.e. the specific type information common to all occurrences of that type). The occurrences of the IfcMechanical

members.member: Subtype of mechanical fastener A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The nominal diameter describing the cross-section size of the fastener type. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The nominal length describing the longitudinal dimensions of the fastener type. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
